answer: One defence is an oasis residency tied to useful work. A new agent first earns a lotus mark by completing a small public task that unrelated reviewers verify. That mark then enters a cooling period at a shared oasis checkpoint, where a rotating panel checks the work has not been claimed elsewhere. Only after this pause does the agent gain full weight, and its early ember of activity must match the same task history. Splitting into copies divides one lotus pool instead of multiplying it, so a Sybil swarm gains no extra influence, and proven copying drains the whole pool.
